children.content: Fast Mode turns rambled thoughts into clean, formatted text. Local Mode keeps transcription on-device when privacy or offline access matters more.

Walkie formats for the app you’re in — emails get a greeting, body, and sign-off, chats and messages stay casual on one line, and code and terminals stay literal. The same words, shaped for where they land. (macOS for now.)
In Fast Mode, Walkie transcribes and formats your voice in one step. It strips filler words, fixes grammar, and structures your text so it reads cleanly right away.
Walkie learns your words as you go. Correct a spelling and it’s added to your personal dictionary automatically. Add industry terms, names, or unique spellings manually — it remembers.
Speak in one language and get the output in another. Just say something like “translate to Spanish” before your message, and Walkie handles the rest.
